title: Efficient Toxicity Detection in Gaming Chats: A Comparative Study of Embeddings, Fine-Tuned Transformers and LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of model misclassifications to identify how systems misinterpret gaming-specific slang, regional dialects, and context-dependent subcultural expressions as toxic.

Comparative computational and financial cost analysis across different NLP approaches (API charges, hardware requirements, inference latency) to evaluate the economic accessibility barriers of deploying advanced moderation systems.
